notes.title: East Coastway Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Train Sim World 2020 – East Coastway Update – 12th December 2019[/h1]

We are bringing an update to Train Sim World 2020. This update improves functionality of numerous Train Sim World add-ons, as well as adds support for the upcoming East Coastway route. Please find the full update log below:


[b]Core[/b]

·        Added Camera Motion Sway feature which can be enabled or disabled in the game settings menu.
·        Resolved an issue whereby player loco level could be miscalculated for mastery rewards.
·        Resolved an issue whereby the brake type for the currently operating loco could alter when repeatedly sitting in the driver’s seat.
·        Resolved an issue whereby platform stop markers could be rendered offset to the track.
·        Resolved an issue whereby pressing the emergency stop button would not cut the operating loco’s engines.


[b]Great Western Express[/b]

·        Resolved an issue whereby player could walk through closed gangway doors on the Class 166.
·        Updated audio occlusion modelling across the Class 66 front and rear cabs.
·        Class 66 HUD now shows target speed when slow speed setting is active.

[b]Northern Trans-Pennine[/b]

·        Resolved an issue whereby the ‘Manchester-Leeds All stops’ service on NTP Journey mode could become blocked for completion.
·        Resolved an issue whereby the ‘0921 Leeds - Manchester Express’ service could become blocked for completion, due to a non-cleared signal at Leeds main platform.
·        Improved NPC texture memory usage toward improved title stability.

[b]Main-Spessart Bahn[/b]

·        Resolved an issue whereby ‘DB88119 Gemünden-Aschaffenburg’, ‘DB86109 Aschaffenburg- Gemünden’ and ‘DB 83175 Heigenbrucken – Gemunden’ services could become blocked for completion.
·        Added schedule times to all stops on the timetable services.
·        Updated brake simulation on the DB Habiins 344 wagon.
·        Resolved an issue whereby the DB BR 146 tutorial could become blocked for completion whilst awaiting brakes to charge.
·        Resolved several instances of incorrect secondary speeds reported across the route.

[b]DB BR 182[/b]

·        Added a notched position for “released” to the direct brake lever.
·        Resolved an issue whereby using AFB could lead to the brakes being locked on.
·        Resolved an issue whereby the Sifa pedal state would not update if already sat in the seat prior to turning Sifa on.
·        Resolved an issue on ‘Night Rider’ scenario where the player could be blocked at Bitterfield awaiting an AI loco to pass.
·        Resolved an issue on ‘Night Rider’ scenario where the player could arrive late into Bitterfield if PZB was active.

[b]DB BR 155[/b]

·        Resolved instances of the 155’s traction motor and brake hiss audio failing to play correctly. 
·        Resolved an issue whereby Sifa could trigger in the BR 155 cab, when driving in a loco coupled to it.
·        Resolved an issue whereby reloading save data on the ‘Lethmathe Lite’ scenario could cause a title crash.
·        Resolved an issue whereby it was possible to block completion of the BR 155 tutorial through invalid settings on the ‘Headlight Brightness’ objective. 
·        Updated brake simulation on the DB Falns 183 wagon.

[b]Rhein-Ruhr Osten[/b]

·        Resolved an issue whereby the ‘Technical Difficulties’ scenario could become blocked for completion.
·        Resolved an issue whereby the EOTD wouldn’t spawn on SGGMRRS wagons.
·        Resolved an issue whereby incorrect wagon type numbers could appear on the Shimmns TTU wagons.
·        Added audio cues for 422 open and close window actions.
·        Resolved an issue whereby audio occlusion could apply incorrectly when opening and closing the 185.2’s doors and windows.
·        Resolved an issue whereby eastbound service locos were displaying incorrect destinations on their display boards.
·        Changed 3car S5 service trains to 4cars to ensure correct service formations.
·        Resolved an issue whereby final tasks in freight services were “Go Via” rather than “Stop At location” instructions.

[b]Ruhr-Sieg Nord[/b]

·        Added “Journey” game mode.
·        Updated scenario and timetable scoring to latest mechanics and added medal rewards.
·        Resolved an issue where tunnel lights could clip the player’s cab interior when driving through Letmathe East tunnel.
·        Updated brake simulation across the Ruhr wagons: DB Shimmns-TTU 722, DB Shimmns-U 708, DB Habbiins 344 and DB Roos-t 645
·        Resolved an issue whereby Sifa could trigger in the BR 143 cab, when driving in a loco coupled to it.
·        Resolved an issue whereby Sifa could trigger in the BR 185.2 cab, when driving in a loco coupled to it.
·        Updates to BR 143 and DB DoppelStockwagen main reservoir and brake pipe cable positioning.

[b]West Somerset Railway[/b]

·        Added “Journey” game mode.

[b]Update Size[/b]
·        WITHOUT East Coastway DLC: 1.6GB
·        WITH East Coastway DLC: 1.6

If you find that after the file verify has completed, you are confident you have not received the update, please contact our Support Team by submitting a ticket to our support site where someone will assist you directly.

notes.title: CSX GP40-2 Beta Update Available Now
notes.content:
Hi all. We have now released a beta update for the CSX GP40-2

Thank you to everyone who has been providing feedback regarding issues with the GP40-2 so far, we have spent a lot of time investigating and working on your reports and today we have opened up a separate branch of Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul, for you to check the immediately proposed fixes below. 

[h1]CHANGELIST[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added localisation in all supported languages (DE, FR, IT, ES, PL and RU)
[*]Fixed Power Line scenario so it can now be completed. 
[*]Fixed a large gap in the window ledge of the GP40-2 model. 
[/list]
How Do I Get Access To This Proposed Update?

By changing the game build using the following steps 

1. Right click on Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul in your Steam Library.
2. Select Properties, then the Beta Tab.
3. Enter the password - gp40preview1
4. Select tsw_gp40-2_patch1 in the drop down.
5. Download the update and launch the game. 
(You'll need to unsubscribe from this branch in order to revert to the currently live version, you can do this by right-clicking on TSW: CSX HH and select None - Opt out of all beta programs) 

[i]We recommend before entering this program making a backup of your profile. You can do this by making a copy of %USERPROFILE%\Documents\My Games\TS2Prototype\Saved\SaveGames and storing it in an easily accessible area on your system.[/i]

Please continue to report any issues that you are experiencing whilst using this test build, this will allow us to thoroughly investigate and collate your feedback with a view to providing a fix as soon as possible, we'll bring you more info on where we go beyond here once we've tested and released this update. We will be here reading everything even if we can’t reply to everyone!

notes.title: Train Sim World Patch Update
notes.content:
Thank you all once again for your continued feedback following the release of the previous Train Sim World update. Your input has helped us identify and address a number of issues, which we have outlined below.

[h1][b]Changelist[/b][/h1]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new function has been added to the locomotives ‘3’ external camera. If the camera becomes stuck by collision, the camera can be reset by pressing CTRL+0.
[*]Collision smoothing for the locomotive ‘3’ external camera.
[*]Fixed an issue where, if the player was crouched and sat in a seat of a locomotive, the character would appear to be floating from an external camera view.
[*]Fixed an issue where at a low random chance, AI trains would disappear in the player’s viewpoint.
[*]Fixed an issue where changing cab ends in any of the included trains, using CTRL and + or – would break the driving HUD.
[*]Updated Service Mode Locomotive Selection screen so the right-hand information updates when the livery is changed.
[*]In-game credits are now translated into French and German.
[*]Removed a cloud of fog that sometimes briefly appeared on the Main Menu Diorama upon first load up.
[/list]

[h1][b]Great Western Express[/b][/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]BR Class 66 EWS livery reskin
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
[*]8 Steam Achievements have been added
[list]
[*]Journey Shrinker – Reach a speed of 125MPH in the HST.
[*]Turbo Power – Reach a speed of 90MPH in the BR Class 166.
[*]Pushing the Limits – Reach a speed of 75MPH in the BR Class 66.
[*]Cross Country – Operate the BR Class 43 HST for 430 miles.
[*]Mile Muncher – Operate the BR Class 166 for 1660 miles.
[*]Powerhauler – Operate the BR Class 66 for 660 miles.
[*]Peak Performance – Successfully completed all scenarios.
[*]Qualified Driver – Successfully completed all introduction tutorials.
[/list][/list]

[h1]Localisation[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements to missing Polish translations.
[*]Fixed missing subtitles when Voice Over was playing in French in the Aggregate Industries scenario.
[/list]

[h1]Environment[/h1]
[list]
[*]Overhead Wire installation in London Paddington station.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Class 43 Introduction Tutorial: Fixed an issue where holding the engine start button down would not complete the objective.
[*]Class 166 Introduction Tutorial: Fixed an issue where holding the engine start button down would not complete the objective.
[*]Class 66 Introduction Tutorial: Fixed an issue where holding the engine start button down would not complete the objective.
[*]Fixed an issue where each locomotive appeared in the list multiple times on the Locomotive Selection screen in Services.
[*]Christmas Closures: Fixed an issue where the BR Class 43 brakes would stop working.
[*]Christmas Closures: Fixed an issue where no power/amps were being applied to the train when following the ‘Switch Cab’ instructions at Acton Yard.
[*]Down the Line: Fixed an issue where the Platform 14 service could not be completed due to an AI train blocking the player path into Southall Platform 3.
[*]Station Stopping Tutorial: Fixed an issue where the player character in an external camera view could be seen in the ‘T’ animation pose as opposed to a seating animation.
[*]Drag Line: Fixed an issue where the seat marker for the HST objective would appear under the world and not on the required cab seat.
[*]Aggregate Industries: Fixed an issue where the ‘Couple to formation’ objective was missing its objective marker.
[*]Aggregate Industries: Fixed an issue where the unloading percentage markers would disappear when saving and reloading this scenario.
[/list]

[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where AWS and DSD alarms could be heard on AI trains from outside of the cab.
[/list]

[h1]BR Class 43 ‘HST’[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements to the Automatic Warning System (AWS).
[*]Improvements to the Train Protection & Warning System (TPWS).
[*]Improvements to the Driver Safety Device (DSD).
[*]Improvements to the Train Brakes so the correct pressures in each stage are being read.
[*]Fix to the Horn, where sometimes interacting with it, no sound could be heard.
[*]Improvements to the Brake Pressure gauges on the driving HUD.
[*]Improvements to the Air Hoses and Multiple Unit cables, where they were dragging through the track/floor.
[*]Improvements to the engine start audio, where before it was too quiet.
[*]Smoke emissions are now present.
[*]Fixed an issue where saving the game whilst the doors were closing/opening would cause them to act strangely on reloading.
[*]Smoothed cab blinds interactions so they no longer snap to locations, they are 100% dynamic.
[/list]

[h1]BR Class 166[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements to the Automatic Warning System (AWS).
[*]Improvements to the Train Protection & Warning System (TPWS).
[*]Improvements to the Driver Safety Device (DSD).
[*]Fix to the Horn, where sometimes interacting with it, no sound could be heard.
[*]Improvements to the Brake Pressure gauges on the driving HUD.
[*]Reduced the window wipers audio, where before it was too loud.
[*]Improvements to the door Hustle Alarm audio and timings.
[*]Smoke emissions are now present.
[*]Fixed an issue with the blinds glitching when using an Xbox controller.
[/list]

[h1]BR Class 66[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements to the Automatic Warning System (AWS).
[*]Improvements to the Train Protection & Warning System (TPWS).
[*]Improvements to the Driver Safety Device (DSD).
[*]Changed the Headlight Switch UI Slider to be horizontal.
[*]Fix to the Horn, where sometimes interacting with it, no sound could be heard.
[*]The rear cab Main Reservoir Pipe and Main Reservoir Dials now show the correct values.
[*]The correct side wipers animate when that side control is used.
[*]Window wipers now clear rain from the window.
[*]Updated Class 66 cab collision to allow the player to have access to the[*]Windscreen wiper controls (which were partially blocked).
[*]Removed snow textures in winter from the roof.
[*]Improvements to the Brake Pressure gauges on the driving HUD.
[*]Smoke emissions are now present.
[*]Improvements to the AMPs meter on the Driving HUD.
[*]Improvements to the Warning Device Icon on the Driving HUD, so it now responds in sync with safety devices (AWS and DSD).
[/list]

[h1]Passengers[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements to passenger train boarding sequence, to prevent them trying to board a train after the loading instruction has complete.
[*]Improvements to skinning to help with hands intersecting with laps when seated, on a bench or in the train.
[*]Added an arms crossed pose for seated characters, with randomised transitions.
[*]Improvements to random head movements which previously appeared ‘robotic’.
[/list]

[h1]Signalling[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix to signal SN203 coming out of Acton Yard, where the train brakes would trigger an Emergency Brake Application when passing at 20MPH, for service 4V38.
[*]Fix to signals T1675 and SN25 TPWS ramps which were triggering brake applications on a double yellow aspect.
[/list]

[h1]Service Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements to some services stopping at the wrong location at platforms.
[*]Fixed AI services spawning in from portals sometimes appearing backwards.
[*]Fixes to services 2N52, 2R19, 2P67 and 5P17 where the incorrect door side would need to opened to complete objectives.
[*]Fixed the player not spawning into a locomotive when selecting service 2P71 Reading to London Paddington.
[/list]

[h1][b]CSX Heavy Haul[/b][/h1]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that was preventing the Turntable tutorial being completed.
[/list]

[h1]AC4400CW[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a performance stutter when jumping to an external camera view from the first person camera view.
[/list]

This update is around 600 MB in size and will download automatically from Steam. If you have any problems/queries with regard to the update, leave a comment below or submit a ticket to our support site where our Support Team will be ready to assist.

[b]Please Note: You may need to restart your Steam Client in order to receive this update and/or commence the download. Please try this before contacting us.[/b]

If you have any feedback in regards to the update, we urge you to post in our dedicated Train Sim World Forums - https://forums.dovetailgames.com/forums/train-sim-world.72

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support, please keep it coming!

notes.title: V1.4 Bright Future Update Out Now
notes.content:
Hi all. Today we've released our 1.4 Update 'Bright Future'.

As we're certain you all already know, YN2 or Bright Future is a paint scheme variation for CSX's Locos, introduced in the 1990s. As a thank you for being with us on this journey from launch to today, we've released the Bright Future paint scheme for free for each loco in Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul. 

This update also contains additional fixes as referenced below, and does now mark our slow down on the release of new updates. We will, of course, be merging some outstanding issue fixes into our next BIG destination for Train Sim World. We'll update you on that soon... 

We have delivered 4 major updates since launch, and fixed 100+ individual items in those updates. So if you ever tested on our beta branch, or alerted us to an issue, or had an idea or a constructive comment on Train Sim World so far, we thank you.

Get into service mode and scenarios to operate with your new paint schemes, and post a screenshot!

[b] Full Patch Notes: [/b]

[h1]New Features [/h1]
[list]
[*]      CSX YN2 "Bright Future" paint scheme variants added for each
locomotive
[*]       Service Mode and Scenarios Updated to incorporate the new paint
scheme variants
[/list]
[h1]Save/Reload [/h1]
[list]
[*]       Fixed save/reload for Clear Cut scenario
[/list]
[h1] General [/h1]
[list]
[*]       Removed the cube from beneath the Autorack Freight Car
[*]      A number of Key Rebinding System fixes as per customer feedback
[*]       Update to AC4400CW Bell Sound/Animation
[*]       Changed all "elephant" style consists to back-to-back
[*]       Changed all single-loco consist to have a back-to-back pair at the
front
[*]       Changed Baltimore services so that they use single-stack cars
[/list]
[h1]Unsubscribing from Test Builds[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Load Steam and navigate to your Game Library.
[*]Right-click on Train Sim World: CSX Heavy Haul and select Properties.
[*]Select the Betas Tab and from the drop-down box, select [b]None – Opt out of all beta programs[/b] from the list.
[*]Click Close and allow Steam to update.
[*]If Steam fails to update, please select Exit from the Steam menu and then relaunch Steam. If you still do not receive the update, please submit a ticket to our [url=https://dovetailgames.kayako.com]Support Team[/url].
[/olist]
This Update will be approximately [b]470 MB[/b] in size.

notes.title: Train Sim World Update 3 (Build #52) Now Live
notes.content:
Today we have made our third update (Build #52) for Train Sim World available to everyone. There is no need to subscribe to a test build as this will update the default installation. If you’re currently subscribed to a test build, you’ll be automatically deferred to the main build. We’d like to give a big thank you to all of you who have consistently and constructively offered your feedback and encouragement.

Here are the items addressed in Build #52:

[h1]Load/Save Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Further work has been done on identifying entities not correctly persisting and restoring state.
[*]Identified and fixed the cause of some voice overs occasionally not playing on restore.
[/list]
[h1]Optimisations[/h1]
[list]
[*]This build contains the first of our multi-threading improvements. In this build, SimuGraph® will use as many CPU cores as are available, to concurrently evaluate SimuGraph processing on all rail vehicles. This reduces the FPS impact when you sit in a locomotive, and should deliver a greater benefit if more cores are available. We are continuing work in this area.
[*]Improvement to non-player train physics performance.
[*]Other optimisation improvements, particularly when interacting with the AC4400CW IFDs.
[*]Reviewed and corrected lighting setup on rail vehicles.
[*]Changed foliage MiP handling to improve the distant view and deliver a performance improvement.
[/list]
[h1]Keyboard Support[/h1]
[list]
[*]We have added support for a wide array of International Keyboards.
[/list]
[h1]Rail Vehicles[/h1]
[list]
[*]General improvements to the brake pipes.
[*]Corrected the Ditch light functionality on the AC4400CW and SD40-2.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause you to Crash to Desktop while attempting to tab a signal in Cumberland Charge. Additional guidance on this scenario is listed under Known Issues.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause you to Crash to Desktop when loading the last save point in Helping Hand.
[*]Fixed an issue that would prevent you from completing the Fully Fuelled scenario.
[/list]
[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]Missing coupling audio added.
[*]Engine audio improvements.
[*]Horn audio improvements.
[*]Improvements to the Cab Occlusion system .
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]At the end of the Cumberland Charge scenario, extra vigilance should be paid to ensure your train is following the light blue line indicated on the 2D Map, as your enter Cumberland Yard. This may require more switches than those indicated, to be changed in order to reach the correct destination.
[*]There are still some instances where Saved sessions fail to initialise properly on reloading. We are working to resolve all remaining instances. We would advise you avoid using the Save/Load feature for the time-being.
[/list]
The Train Sim World update will download automatically on Steam. If you are not receiving this update, please double-check that Steam has correctly unsubscribed you from test builds:

[h1]Unsubscribing from Test Builds[/h1]

notes.title: Update 2 Released
notes.content:
Following on from last weeks post as detailed below - we are now releasing Update 2 to all TSW: CSX Heavy Haul owners which addresses the following issues/bugs: 

FULL PATCH NOTES 

[i] Patch Size: 600mb [/i]

[b]Load/Save Issues [/b]
[list]
[*]A Crash on loading previous saves has been identified and we believe resolved
[*]The dispatcher not being properly re-initialised on reloading some saves has been resolved
[*]We have identified some control states on the locomotives and rolling stock were not being restored correctly on loading and have rectified this
[*]Objective markers were sometimes not re-appearing on loading a save game.
[/list]
[b]Optimisation[/b]
[list]
[*]We have found some issues with the render distances for Splines and Foliage to be set too far out and have reduced these to more appropriate settings for a decent performance improvement.
[*]Some work has been done to optimise the tasks going on for managing AI trains in the background and reduce their overhead.
[*]We have reviewed dynamic shadow casting and optimised how and where this is being done.
[*]We have removed unnecessary shadow casting from lights in the menu background for a good framerate improvement while in the menu.
[*]There have also been a few other minor optimisations to various areas around the game.
[/list]
[b]Keyboard Support[/b]
We have added support for the following keyboards:
[list]
[*]Turkish
[*]Russian
[*]Czech
[*]US_International
[*]Swiss German
[*]French
[*]French Canadian
[*]Polish
[*]Spanish
[*]Italian
[*]Arabic
[/list]
[b]Rail Vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*]Incorrect ditch light behaviour on GP38-2 and AC4400CW has been fixed
[*]Culling on SD40-2 when looking at rear wall has been fixed
[*]The Dynamic brake on the HUD was showing positive amps when it should be negative, this has now been fixed.
[*]Fuel consumption values for all three locomotives have been adjusted.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]A number of achievements were being issued simultaneously for incorrect reasons, these have all been reviewed and are now working correctly.
[*]We identified an additional situation in which a train could derail and not cause the end-game sequence to trigger.
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Compressor and Brake discharge audio volume has been increased
[*]Missing hand brake chain sound on box car has been added
[*]Whistle board had an electrical hum sound, this has been removed.
[/list]

Update 2 will download automatically from Steam and will be approximately 600MB in size.
